summary: Two hikers left the Colorado National Monument visitor center, got off trail and became lost; Mesa County SAR deployed; both were located in good health, in cell contact with rangers and dispatch.
notes: DATE APPROXIMATE: Townsquare page 'last updated' metadata ~4540 days before 2026-09-15; no weekday cross-check available. Distinct from the 2019-04-14 Red Canyon father/daughter row (id 2316).
